text: Unfortunately, despite the medical records, the doctor did everything "wrong" that worsened my radical nerve neuroma and CRPS2. Since the natto and infusion, I've had significantly more problems, which could even lead to amputation of my hand. She didn't care how bad I felt afterward; she just wanted to schedule another appointment. I paid a lot for a doubled worsening of my condition, culminating in the amputation of my hand. Luckily, I'm now flying to a good hospital after 2.5 years of poor treatment in Phuket and Bangkok. For money, many will do anything, regardless of the patient's condition.
